title: France withdraws support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino's re-election bid
summary: The French Football Federation (FFF) has withdrawn its support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino's bid for re-election in March 2027. The decision was made during a meeting of the FFF's executive committee on Thursday. Infantino has faced criticism for a failed commercial partnership project. Separately, FIFA has been accused of not investigating Infantino ally Samuel Eto'o.
summary_points: The French Football Federation (FFF) withdrew support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino's re-election.
Infantino is seeking re-election in March 2027.
The FFF's executive committee made the decision on Thursday.
Infantino has faced criticism over a failed commercial partnership project.
FIFA has been accused of not investigating Infantino ally Samuel Eto'o.

summary_hi: फ्रांसीसी फुटबॉल महासंघ (FFF) ने फीफा अध्यक्ष जियानी इन्फेंटिनो की मार्च 2027 में पुनः चुनाव की बोली के लिए अपना समर्थन वापस ले लिया है। यह निर्णय गुरुवार को FFF की कार्यकारी समिति की बैठक के दौरान लिया गया। इन्फेंटिनो को एक असफल वाणिज्यिक साझेदारी परियोजना के लिए आलोचना का सामना करना पड़ा है। अलग से, फीफा पर इन्फेंटिनो के सहयोगी सैमुअल एटो की जांच न करने का आरोप लगाया गया है।
